title: Autonomous Agents
description: Idle teammates discover ready tasks on a shared board and use an atomic claim before starting work.

steps.content: Update the API examples, then add tests that use the final examples.
steps.annotation: The request contains two tasks with a clear dependency.
The Lead creates the first task in the shared graph.
The second task cannot start until the examples are complete.
Existing IDLE teammates scan the board after waiting for messages.
The ownership check and pending-to-in_progress update are atomic.

steps.content: claim_next_task(bob) -> no ready task; remain IDLE
steps.annotation: The test task is still blocked, so Bob does not start it early.
Completing the examples unblocks the dependent test task.
Bob claims the newly ready work without another direct assignment.
